prompt.text:
Implement a self-contained CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ validateProfile }`. `validateProfile(input)` accepts a plain object with `displayName`, `email`, and `biography`. A non-object or array is treated as an object with all fields missing. Each field is normalized by trimming surrounding whitespace; non-string fields normalize to an empty string. A valid display name contains 2 through 40 characters. A valid email contains exactly one `@`, has non-empty local and domain parts, contains no whitespace, and its domain contains a dot that is neither its first nor last character. A valid biography contains 10 through 500 characters after trimming. Return `{ ok, errors, value }`, where `value` is a fresh normalized object and `errors` is a fresh object containing only invalid field names mapped to `INVALID_DISPLAY_NAME`, `INVALID_EMAIL`, or `INVALID_BIOGRAPHY`. `ok` is true only when errors is empty. Do not mutate or alias the input.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
